author: Yffe
content: Pinned: lean/Thermite/PinExportCapture.lean (kernel-checked). substitute() handles binder SHADOWING (removes the shadowed subst key at a Closure/match binder) but never alpha-renames when a substituted ARG carries a free name equal to the binder. Live repro: spec fn cntk(xs,v)=count_where(xs,|k| k as int == v) called as cntk(xs, k as int) unfolds to count_where(xs,|k| k as int == k as int) — the caller's k is CAPTURED (count-of-equal-to-k becomes count-all). The kernel facts: captured form denotes 2 on xs=[0,1],k=0; the faithful substitution denotes 1 (capture_changes_meaning). The emitted theorem for the semantically FALSE contract 'ens cntk(xs, k as int) == cntall(xs)' is kernel-PROVABLE (thermite_obligation_f3); today discharge returns Unknown only because auto_tactic_battery errors 'No goals to be solved' when its leading simp closes the goal — an accident, not a gate. §6.1(b): the unfolded Expr MUST equal the real body substituted.
